citation: Verdict refactor spec (docs/methodology_refactor.md, verdict piece): Thomastown's stop-level mode split previously quoted a bus headway most residents cannot walk to (reachShare ~7%) while calling the suburb STRANDED, a self-contradiction the population-weighted reach gate replaces.
Verdict refactor spec: Deanside's binding constraint is unreachable stops (a coverage/reach problem), not unreliable service once reached -- the reliability qualifier must not fire here.

Verdict refactor spec: Pakenham mixes hourly V/Line-style bus feeders with turn-up-and-go metro trains; the quoted headway must describe one population-weighted mode group, not a blended average across both.
Healthy inner-Melbourne control (GOOD band, reachShare 1.0 as generated) to catch REACH_CRITICAL overfiring on well-served suburbs.
